notes.title: First time greeting!♥
notes.notes:
Hello!
I'm Elin, the owner of this place!

I realize I haven't said hello to you since we opened the shop.

Well, I'm writing to tell you that our shop has gotten a new look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137393/4d09e4f471c9e47336e4920052b68b414f37d31c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137393/d6e3ad016a7281029d08ca6a6b7b64f5cbb5db8e.gif[/img]

It's a lot different from what you saw last time, isn't it?
(I'm a little embarrassed to show up...♥)

Anyway!!!
I'm sure there's a lot more stuff you'll like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137393/e4a612ec0f488bcbb43545f7ba332355163acaa4.gif[/img]

Lastly!
Do you agree not to tell anyone about what happened here?!
Got it...?♥
